name: Unplundered Tomb South of Dravesa
status_note: Interior unknown — not yet developed. Needs a full site file before the party returns.
location: South of Dravesa, exact position unrecorded

overview.what_it_is: A single unplundered tomb of unknown provenance south of Dravesa.
overview.current_state: Unplundered at time of first visit (Session 26). Interior unexplored.
overview.historical_context: Ossek Thrice-Buried believes the inscriptions may connect to pre-Silence arcane knowledge on conditional immortality, possibly Ameniseb's work.

approach_vectors.name: Overland from Dravesa
approach_vectors.description: Travel south from Dravesa through jackalwere-infested territory to reach the tomb exterior.
approach_vectors.notes: Jackalwere infestation in surrounding area — numbers and lair location unknown. Deal with or avoid jackalwere perimeter before attempting entry.

ossek_thrice_buried.name: Ossek Thrice-Buried
ossek_thrice_buried.goal: Full inscription rubbing — specifically wants to read and copy the tomb inscriptions at any cost. Will recruit Zardoon; will risk his life and others' for the inscriptions.
ossek_thrice_buried.notes: Identified the site and led Zardoon there; knows exterior layout; no interior knowledge. Interest level: obsessed. Has Aurka network contacts.

ossek-thrice-buried.name: Ossek Thrice-Buried
ossek-thrice-buried.psychology: Obsessed with inscription content; cannot be controlled and will get people killed pursuing a rubbing. Three dead partners (Nevret, Bressul, Davanek) are his track record.

reactions.inscriptions_found: Will demand full rubbing at any cost; disregards party safety.
reactions.denied_access: Will push back hard and attempt to find another way in.

specialist_knowledge: Ossek knows: tomb location, jackalwere infestation in the area, belief that inscriptions connect to Ameniseb and pre-Silence conditional immortality. Cost to acquire: Zardoon's hands, eyes, and feet. Accuracy: high on exterior, none on interior.

knowledge: Tomb inscriptions — Ossek believes they relate to pre-Silence conditional immortality, possibly Ameniseb's work
strategic_value: Aurka network access through Ossek Thrice-Buried

hooks: Ossek wants to return for a full inscription rubbing — will recruit Zardoon.
Pre-Silence conditional immortality angle may connect to larger campaign threads.
Aurka network access through Ossek is a secondary reward.

lore_threads: Conditional immortality inscription content should tie to whatever pre-Silence lore is already canon.

dm_notes.design_intent: Develop interior before the party returns. Ossek's three dead partners (Nevret, Bressul, Davanek) are a tone-setter — this site should feel genuinely dangerous.
integration_points: Jackalwere infestation: decide whether they have a lair nearby or are transient — not just flavor, a real perimeter threat.
Conditional immortality inscription content should tie to whatever pre-Silence lore is already canon.
Ossek cannot be controlled and will get people killed pursuing a rubbing.
